procedure.method: Fresh independent portfolio review; no agent was spawned, resumed or forked and no peer/producer/planner records were read. Read the pinned packet, literal case, rubric, review rules, recording README/addendum, adapter, ratio policy and all five pinned native-evidence manifests, without following their unlisted embedded paths. Verified the bytes/hashes of every listed pin and PNG dimensions. The packet has no source_assets and no protected_layouts, so there were no source asset opens or protected geometry manifests to read. Actually opened and visually received each exact poster through tools.view_image, emitted with detail original: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All fifteen were completed before the first poster copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment, rating or diversity assessment. Then read the displayed native pixels for all twelve entries per member in packet order; first raw readings below retain visible soft wraps. No copy ambiguity required a revisit, and no additional image open, crop, replacement or regeneration was used. Assessed actual pixels at the three received sizes; file verification or helper completion was not treated as image viewing. Native dimensions are 1672x941; the predeclared aspect-only rounding allowance accepts the 0.5-pixel height deviation from exact 16:9. Usage views are 720x405, thumbnails 320x180. RGB native PNG headers and fully filled poster fields support the opaque flat poster condition. No unobservable runtime session or serialized viewing event ID is claimed.

There are real local differences in crop, photography versus illustration, brush/serif/gothic roles and the position of imagery. They support partial diversity, rather than five genuinely distinct complete systems.

M2, M3 and M5 most clearly share a framed central opening with title/slogan/explanation and paired event/application groups. M1 moves imagery above that scaffold; M4 shifts it asymmetrically without fully changing the practical reading organization.
Diversity is an independent full-set judgment of 3, below the unchanged required floor of 4. No averaging of the individual scores is used.
This record is one portfolio critic’s assessment of the exact selected packet. It does not establish the other two critics’ judgments or a combined three-critic gate.
